question: Which parts are below their reorder point, counting available stock (on hand minus allocated) across all warehouses?
gold_sql: SELECT p.part_number FROM parts p JOIN inventory i ON i.part_id=p.part_id GROUP BY p.part_id HAVING SUM(i.qty_on_hand-i.qty_allocated) < p.reorder_point
pred_sql:
SELECT p."part_id",
       p."part_number",
       p."description",
       p."reorder_point",
       COALESCE(SUM(i."qty_on_hand" - i."qty_allocated"), 0) AS "available_qty"
FROM parts p
LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i."part_id" = p."part_id"
GROUP BY p."part_id", p."part_number", p."description", p."reorder_point"
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(i."qty_on_hand" - i."qty_allocated"), 0) < p."reorder_point"
ORDER BY (p."reorder_point" - COALESCE(SUM(i."qty_on_hand" - i."qty_allocated"), 0)) DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: Who are our top 3 customers by revenue on shipped orders?

question: For parts below their reorder point (available stock across warehouses), who is the supplier? Skip parts we make ourselves.

       p."description",
       s."name" AS "supplier",

FROM parts p
JOIN suppliers s ON s."supplier_id" = p."supplier_id"

question: How many units are still to be received on open or partially received purchase orders, per part number?
gold_sql: SELECT p.part_number, SUM(l.qty_ordered-l.qty_received) FROM po_lines l JOIN purchase_orders o ON o.po_id=l.po_id JOIN parts p ON p.part_id=l.part_id WHERE o.status IN ('Open','Partially received') GROUP BY p.part_number
pred_sql:
SELECT p."part_number",
       SUM(pl."qty_ordered" - pl."qty_received") AS "qty_outstanding"
FROM "po_lines" pl
JOIN "purchase_orders" po ON po."po_id" = pl."po_id"
JOIN "parts" p ON p."part_id" = pl."part_id"
WHERE (po."status" = 'Open' OR po."status" LIKE 'Partial%')
  AND pl."qty_ordered" > pl."qty_received"
GROUP BY p."part_number"
ORDER BY "qty_outstanding" DESC;

question: On orders that were not cancelled, do dealers or direct farms pay a lower average unit price for the Bale processor BP-500?
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(AVG(l.unit_price),2) FROM so_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.so_id=l.so_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN parts p ON p.part_id=l.part_id WHERE p.description='Bale processor BP-500' AND o.status<>'Cancelled' GROUP BY c.segment
pred_sql:
SELECT c."segment",
       COUNT(*) AS "line_count",
       SUM(sl."qty") AS "total_qty",
       AVG(sl."unit_price") AS "avg_unit_price",
       SUM(sl."qty" * sl."unit_price") * 1.0 / SUM(sl."qty") AS "qty_weighted_avg_price"
FROM so_lines sl
JOIN sales_orders so ON so."so_id" = sl."so_id"
JOIN customers c ON c."customer_id" = so."customer_id"
JOIN parts p ON p."part_id" = sl."part_id"
WHERE so."status" <> 'Cancelled'
  AND c."segment" IN ('Dealer', 'Direct farm')
  AND (p."description" LIKE '%Bale processor BP-500%' OR p."part_number" = 'BP-500')
GROUP BY c."segment"
ORDER BY "avg_unit_price" ASC
LIMIT 5;
